scope: Game frame/work recording, not CPU profiler percentages. Frame N work is compared to frame N+1 gap. GC counter includes collections on any thread; does not isolate disk waiting versus serialization/GC within the save.
conclusion: All 26 walking gaps of at least 50 ms follow synchronous main-thread save work. This identifies the save path as the dominant recurring stall in this capture; it does not prove every smaller gap has the same cause.
